ReconEval#

Benchmark for gene-expression reconstruction from single-cell latent representations. The package contains:

  • a metrics API that scores a (true, reconstructed) anndata.AnnData pair (statistical, biological, perturbational);

  • four tutorial notebooks covering the three benchmark settings;

  • training and eval pipelines under experiments/ with Hydra configs and sbatch wrappers;

  • analysis notebooks under analysis/ that reproduce the paper figures from cached metric CSVs.

Install

pip install -e . for the metrics API; conda env for the full benchmark.
